claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Trichostatin A at 2.5 uM kills cells primarily through potent HDAC inhibition, causing histone hyperacetylation, cell-cycle arrest, differentiation and apoptosis, with a broad antiproliferative pattern rather than a single lineage-selective off-target effect.
